summary.result: The objective of this study was to enforce systematic evaluation on the present condition and ecosystem of coastal wetland to use frame of environmental indicators, For this, the indicators for evaluation of coastal wetland were established and were applied to the present condition.
summary.background: Then, the application possibility of this evaluation indicators and management method by group of coastal method are presented.
summary.method: In case of Kang-hwa island which had the good natural environment, the mlnimum development with maintenance of the present state must be driven.
